articles.summary: Managing all the interconnected systems within a building, from the convergence of Wi-Fi and cellular to the convergence of IT and OT, places a heavy burden on teams that were not built for it.
articles.title: MetaLynx: Unifying Building Connectivity and Control at the Edge

articles.summary: For residents of Tanara Chepo, no fixed broadband access meant TV without apps, phones without Wi-Fi, and kids who couldn’t stream educational videos. We wanted to change that.
articles.title: Connecting Tanara Chepo: How AirLynx Brought Smart Internet to a Community Off the Map
